question_text: A water reservoir for a barangay can be filled by Pump A in 4 hours and by Pump B in 6 hours. How long will it take to fill the reservoir if both pumps work together?

hint_ladder.title: Convert times to rates
hint_ladder.text: Huwag mag-focus sa 4 at 6 na oras. I-convert ito sa 'part of job per hour': Pump A = 1/4, Pump B = 1/6.

hint_ladder.title: Add the two rates
hint_ladder.text: Pag sabay sila, add mo ang 1/4 + 1/6. Gamit ang common denominator 12: 3/12 + 2/12 = 5/12 kada oras.

hint_ladder.title: Flip the combined rate
hint_ladder.text: Ang 5/12 ang bahagi na tapos sa isang oras. Para malaman buong oras, kunin ang reciprocal: 12/5 hours.

A.text: Correct. Add their rates: 1/4+1/6=5/12 per hour, then reciprocal 12/5=2.4. Shortcut: (4×6)/(4+6)=2.4.

B.text: You might have chosen B because you averaged the times (4+6)/2=5 then halved to 2.5, but rates don't average—they add.

C.text: You might have chosen C because you simply averaged 4 and 6, but working together is always faster than either alone, so it can't be 5 ho...

D.text: You might have chosen D because you added 4+6=10, thinking pumps work sequentially, but they work together simultaneously.

next_time_rule: For combined work problems, never average times. Use shortcut (A×B)/(A+B). Remember: rates add, times don't. Parang pagtutulungan sa barangay—mas mabilis!
deconstruct_text:
Imagine you're a Barangay Kagawad sa Masigla, planning the water reservoir filling for the barangay fiesta. Pump A fills it in 4 hours, Pump B in 6 hours. Kung sabay silang gagana, gaano kabilis?

Ang key dito: i-convert ang 'oras to finish' into 'rate per hour.' Pump A nagfi-fill ng 1/4 ng reservoir bawat oras, Pump B ng 1/6. Pag pinagsama, add mo ang rates: 1/4 + 1/6 = 5/12 ng reservoir kada oras. This is their combined rate.

Para makuha total time, kunin ang reciprocal: 12/5 = 2.4 oras. Shortcut: (A×B)/(A+B) = (4×6)/(4+6)=2.4. Mental trick: Parang naghahati ng lechon sa handaan—pag dalawa ang tagahiwa, mas mabilis! I-add ang kanilang hiwa per minuto bago baliktarin.
